name: Barbell Alternating Reverse Lunges
setup_cues: Set the bar on a rack at chest height and unrack it with both feet under the bar. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, wrists straight, elbows pointing down. | Leave enough space behind you to step back safely; use the rack safety pins. | Start with an empty bar until the movement feels steady.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Facepulls
setup_cues: Set the cable pulley at face height and use the rope attachment. | Hold the rope with thumbs pointing back towards you. | Pull the rope ends apart beside your ears; keep your ribs down. | Choose a light weight: you should control the return without being pulled forward.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Bench Hops
setup_cues: Only use a very stable, low step or bench that cannot slide; clear the floor around you. | Wear shoes with grip; skip this exercise on a slippery floor.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Bodyweight standing calf raise
setup_cues: Hold a wall, chair back or door frame lightly for balance. | Stand on the edge of a stair for a bigger range once the floor version feels easy.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Dead bug
setup_cues: Use a mat or carpet so your back is comfortable. | Move slowly; if your lower back lifts off the floor, reduce how far you reach.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Dumbbell bent over row

mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
setup_cues: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; stand with your back against a wall to stop swinging.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Forward lunge (male)
setup_cues: Clear a space about two steps long in front of you. | Hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Low glute bridge on floor
setup_cues: Use a mat on the floor; place your heels about a hand's length from your hips.

name: Push-up

mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Walking lunge
setup_cues: You need a clear hallway or room length; walk in a straight line.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Bodyweight squat
setup_cues: Place a chair behind you as a target and safety: lightly touch it and stand up. | Keep your weight across your whole foot, not only the toes.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Barbell back squat
setup_cues: Set the bar in the rack at mid-chest height and the safety pins just below your lowest squat depth. | Grip the bar evenly, hands just outside your shoulders, wrists straight; rest it on your upper back, not your neck. | Step back only two or three small steps and set your feet shoulder-width apart. | Ask for a spotter or use safety pins; start with the empty bar.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Forearm plank
setup_cues: Use a mat or carpet under your forearms. | Look at the floor between your hands to keep your neck long.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Side plank
setup_cues: Use a mat; bend your knees for an easier version.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Bird dog
setup_cues: Use a mat; place a cushion under your knees if needed.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Wall push up
setup_cues: Place hands on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing up. | The further your feet are from the wall, the harder it becomes.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Knee push up
setup_cues: Put a folded towel or mat under your knees. | Hands a little wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
setup_cues: Use light dumbbells or water bottles; sit on a sturdy chair with back support if standing is hard.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
setup_cues: Use very light dumbbells or water bottles; lighter is better here.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Band row
setup_cues: Anchor the band in a closed door with a door anchor or around a sturdy post. | Check the band for cracks before every session.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Bodyweight hip hinge
setup_cues: Hold a broomstick along your back touching head, upper back and tailbone to learn a straight back.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Low step up
setup_cues: Use the bottom stair or a very stable, low step; hold the handrail.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: March in place
setup_cues: Any clear space works; march on a carpet or mat to reduce impact.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Standing calf stretch
setup_cues: Use a wall or door frame for support.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Standing breathing
setup_cues: Sit or stand anywhere quiet.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Seated knee lift
setup_cues: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Wall sit
setup_cues: Use a smooth wall; place a mat under your feet so they do not slide.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Heel raise balance
setup_cues: Stand next to a wall, counter or chair back.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

name: Lat pulldown
setup_cues: Adjust the thigh pad so you cannot lift off the seat. | Use a grip just wider than shoulders; thumbs around the bar. | Pull to the top of your chest, never behind the neck. | Pick a weight you can pull without swinging your body.
mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging the body. | Pulling the bar behind the neck.

name: Seated cable row
setup_cues: Use the V-handle with palms facing each other. | Keep your chest up; do not lean back more than a little. | Pull elbows close to your sides toward your hips.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach forward. | Jerking the weight with the body.

name: Triceps pushdown
setup_cues: Pin your elbows to your sides; only the forearms move. | With a rope, spread the ends apart at the bottom. | Choose a weight you can control without leaning over it.
mistakes: Letting elbows move forward and back. | Leaning over the weight.

name: Pec deck (butterfly machine)
setup_cues: Set the seat so your elbows are level with your shoulders. | Keep shoulders down and back against the pad. | Stop opening when you feel a gentle stretch, not pain in the shoulder.
mistakes: Letting the arms go too far back. | Shrugging the shoulders.

name: Machine chest press
setup_cues: Set the seat so handles are at mid-chest, not at the neck. | Grip with wrists straight and elbows slightly below shoulder height. | Breathe out as you press, in as you return.
mistakes: Locking the elbows hard. | Lifting the back off the pad.

name: Leg press
setup_cues: Feet flat, hip-width, in the middle of the platform. | Lower only as far as your lower back stays on the pad. | Lock the safety handles before getting out.
mistakes: Letting the lower back round off the seat at the bottom. | Locking the knees at the top.

name: Leg extension
setup_cues: Line up your knee with the red pivot dot on the machine. | Hold the side handles to keep your hips on the seat. | Use a light weight and move slowly; stop if the knee hurts.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up fast. | Lifting the hips off the seat.

name: Seated leg curl
setup_cues: Line up your knees with the pivot point of the machine. | Lower the thigh pad until it holds your legs firmly. | Hold the handles and move slowly in both directions.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull your legs up quickly. | Lifting the hips or leaning back to move the weight.

name: Barbell bench press
setup_cues: Set safety arms just below chest height or ask for a spotter. | Squeeze shoulder blades together and keep feet flat. | Wrists straight over elbows; start with the empty bar.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest. | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

name: Barbell deadlift
setup_cues: Learn the hip hinge first; start with a light bar or plates on blocks. | Keep the bar touching your legs the whole time. | Never round your back to reach the bar.
mistakes: Rounding the back. | Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

name: Romanian deadlift
setup_cues: Start from standing (take the bar from a rack). | Keep the bar close to your legs. | Go down only as far as your back stays flat.
mistakes: Bending the knees too much like a squat. | Rounding the back to go lower.

name: Barbell bent-over row
setup_cues: Grip just wider than shoulders, palms facing you. | Keep your torso still; only the arms move. | Use a light weight first to learn the position.
mistakes: Standing up during each rep. | Rounding the lower back.

name: Cable crossover
setup_cues: Stand in the middle of the station with a split stance. | Keep the elbow bend the same throughout. | Use a light weight; the movement should feel smooth.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a press. | Using too much weight and losing balance.

name: Crunch
setup_cues: Use a mat; keep your chin slightly tucked and do not pull on your neck.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands. | Sitting all the way up quickly.

name: Superman
setup_cues: Use a mat; lift only a small height without pain.
mistakes: Lifting too high and straining the lower back. | Holding the breath.

name: Dumbbell hammer curl
setup_cues: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; stand against a wall to stop swinging.
mistakes: Swinging the body. | Letting elbows move forward.

name: Bench dip
setup_cues: Use a sturdy chair against a wall so it cannot slide; keep knees bent for an easier version.
mistakes: Going too low and straining the shoulders. | Elbows flaring out.

name: Hip adduction machine
setup_cues: Start with a small range; widen it only if your hips feel comfortable. | Keep your back against the pad the whole time.
mistakes: Letting the weight slam the legs open. | Leaning forward and rocking the body.

name: Machine shoulder press
setup_cues: Keep your feet flat and your ribs down so your back stays on the pad. | Stop just before your elbows lock.
mistakes: Arching the lower back away from the pad. | Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

name: Assisted pull-up machine
setup_cues: Start with plenty of assistance and reduce it over the weeks. | Keep your shoulders away from your ears as you pull.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking to get up. | Dropping down too fast.

name: Lying leg curl
setup_cues: Keep your hips down on the bench. | Use a weight you can lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the bench. | Letting the weight drop on the way down.

name: Smith machine squat
setup_cues: Always set the safety stops first. | Go only as low as you can keep your back straight.
mistakes: Feet too far back so the knees hurt. | Forgetting to set the safety stops.

name: Hack squat machine
setup_cues: Start light; this machine is harder than the leg press. | Keep your knees in line with your toes.
mistakes: Heels lifting off the platform. | Bouncing at the bottom.

name: Seated calf raise machine
setup_cues: Move slowly and pause at the top. | Push through the big toe side of your foot.
mistakes: Bouncing quickly through short reps. | Rolling onto the outside of the feet.

name: Cable biceps curl
setup_cues: Stand tall and keep your elbows still. | Use a weight you can control on the way down.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight. | Elbows drifting forward.

name: Incline dumbbell press
setup_cues: At home, do incline push-ups with hands on a sturdy table.
mistakes: Bench set too steep, turning it into a shoulder press. | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
setup_cues: At home, use a water bottle or a band.
mistakes: Swinging the upper arm. | Rounding the back.

name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
setup_cues: At home, use a water bottle or a light dumbbell.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide. | Arching the lower back.

name: Hip thrust
setup_cues: Use a bar pad for comfort. | Keep your chin tucked and ribs down at the top.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top. | Feet too close or too far.

name: Pull-up
setup_cues: Use the assisted machine first if you cannot do 5 good reps. | Keep your body still; no swinging.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging. | Doing half reps without lowering fully.

name: Bent-over rear delt raise
setup_cues: At home, use water bottles or a band.
mistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging. | Rounding the back.

name: Barbell biceps curl
setup_cues: An EZ bar is easier on the wrists. | Keep your body still; no swinging.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the bar. | Letting the bar drop quickly.
